page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which consists of 70,866 GB of local hard disk drive storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. The instance does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1.6xlarge is its reliance on traditional HDD storage rather than solid-state drives, which prioritizes sheer storage volume and sequential throughput over random input-output operations. This profile makes the instance suitable for workloads requiring massive data capacity at a lower cost per gigabyte, such as MapReduce jobs, distributed file systems, large-scale data warehousing, cold data storage, and log processing.
